completion.source: Reused from G2_omnipicker: generic actuator settle bounds (joint position and velocity, stable window, arm TCP and IK accuracy) and the joint-position gripper tolerance of the same omnipicker gripper. Fixed base: no chassis standstill limits or roll window.

frame_contract.runtime_source: Reused from G2_omnipicker: the same omnipicker gripper on the same arm end (URDF arm_<side>_end_link -> gripper_<side>_center_link is 0.1431 m along z on both robots); user-provided physical measurement 0.15 m, 2026-09-24. TCP orientation is the arm-end orientation, not the right center link's URDF yaw of pi. The arm base sits behind the uncommanded lift/pitch waist; base_from_arm_base follows the measured waist.

left.joint_limits_rad_source: control_joint physics:lowerLimit/upperLimit, direct unit conversion from USD degrees
left.max_opening_source: Reused from G2_omnipicker: user-provided physical measurement of the same omnipicker gripper, 2026-09-28: maximum opening between the fingertips
left.open_closed_source: Reused from G2_omnipicker by user decision, 2026-09-28: the same omnipicker gripper keeps the public -0.785 (open) .. 0 (closed) range; public = outer_joint1 raw * public_state_scale (-1), so the raw joint opens at 0.785 rad.
left.source: Composed G1_omnipicker robot.usda joint prims: the driven outer_joint1 (0..45 deg) and its inner_joint1 counterpart (-45..0 deg), the same omnipicker linkage as G2_omnipicker. No jaw aperture calibration exists, so the sample carries no aperture evidence.

right.max_opening_source: Reused from G2_omnipicker: user-provided physical measurement of the same omnipicker gripper, 2026-09-28: maximum opening between the fingertips
right.open_closed_source: Reused from G2_omnipicker by user decision, 2026-09-28: the same omnipicker gripper keeps the public -0.785 (open) .. 0 (closed) range; public = outer_joint1 raw * public_state_scale (-1), so the raw joint opens at 0.785 rad.

ik_solver.source: Reused from G2_omnipicker: raw bundled Lula Cartesian replay with SO(3)-bounded orientation convergence. The per-arm descriptions are byte-identical to G2_omnipicker's (the same seven arm joints per side, all present in G1_omnipicker.urdf); the benchmark keeps robot.robot_description for its single right-arm solver.
